meta.title: HilaTech Knowledge Studio — answers from your documents, with sources
meta.description: Turn business documents into a workspace where your team asks questions and checks every answer against its source.

hero.title: Your knowledge, finally within reach.
hero.body: Turn documents into intelligent answers — backed by the sources your team can trust.
hero.visualLabel: Illustration: a question, its answer, and the two document passages the answer is based on.
hero.question: Question
hero.visualNote: Example built from the fictional sample documents in the demo.

product.title: Ask a question. See where the answer comes from.
product.body: Each statement in an answer points to the passage behind it. Choose a question, then select a citation to read the source.
product.note: These answers are pre-written examples, shown to explain how the product works.

how.title: From a folder of files to an answer you can check.

add.title: Add your documents
add.body: Upload PDFs, Word files and text files. Each one is read and indexed, and the library shows when it is ready to answer questions.

ask.title: Ask meaningful questions
ask.body: Ask the way you would ask a colleague, in Hebrew or in English. Follow up without repeating yourself.

verify.title: Verify every answer
verify.body: Open any citation to see the page and the exact passage it came from, next to the answer.

how.status: In development: document upload and live AI answers are being built. The demo currently shows pre-written examples from fictional sample documents.

useCases.title: One workspace, useful to every team.
useCases.body: The same place to ask, whatever the documents are about.

support.body: Agents answer policy questions inside the ticket, without waiting for a team lead.
support.question: What is the refund window for annual plans?

hr.body: New employees find answers on their own, and HR stops repeating them.
hr.question: What do I need to finish in my first week?

ops.body: Procedures are easy to find at the moment someone needs them.
ops.question: Who approves a refund above $400?

docs.body: Engineers and support staff get the relevant section of a long manual.
docs.question: Which steps does the release checklist require before deployment?

trust.title: Built so you can check its work.
trust.body: An answer is only useful if you can rely on it. These are the rules the product is being built around; they describe the design, not a finished service.

private.title: Private documents
private.body: Files are kept in private storage and are used only to answer questions inside your own workspace.

sources.title: Source-based answers
sources.body: Answers are written from passages found in your documents, and each statement links to the passage it relies on.

access.title: Access controls
access.body: Every workspace is separate. People see only the documents of the workspaces they belong to.

unsupported.title: Unsupported questions
unsupported.body: When your documents don't cover a question, the assistant says so instead of guessing.

example.label: When the documents don't have the answer
example.question: What is our parental leave policy?
example.answer: I couldn't find reliable information about that in the available documents.

contact.title: Ready to make your business knowledge searchable?
contact.body: Tell us what your team needs to find. HilaTech will get back to you to arrange a demo.
contact.name: Full name
contact.message: What would you like your team to be able to ask?
contact.successBody: Thank you. Your request was received.

errors.email: Enter a valid email address, such as name@company.com.
errors.tooLong: Shorten this to {max} characters or fewer.
errors.server: Your request wasn't sent. Check your connection and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests from this device. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.unavailable: Requests can't be received right now, so yours wasn't sent. Please try again later.

footer.tagline: Your knowledge. Instant answers. Verified sources.
footer.disclosure: An independent demonstration product by HilaTech. Northstar Business Services and its documents are fictional.

preview.banner: Answers on this screen are pre-written examples based on fictional documents. Live AI answers are not connected yet.

empty.title: What would you like to know?
empty.body: Ask about Northstar's policies, plans and procedures. Every answer shows the passages it is based on.

unavailable.title: This preview answers the example questions only
unavailable.body: Your question wasn't sent to an AI model, because live answers are not connected in this preview. Choose an example question to see how answers and sources work.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.notIncluded: The text of this part of the document isn't included in the sample preview.
evidence.note: The highlighted passage is quoted from the document. The answer in the conversation is a summary of it.

notFound.title: This page doesn't exist
notFound.body: The address may be mistyped, or the page may have moved.
